title: LPINNs: First-Layer Gated Localization for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.22984v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) use one shared representation over the computational domain, which can become difficult to optimize on long domains and for high-order operators. We study a minimal alternative: multiply the first hidden activation of an otherwise unchanged dense PINN by input-dependent localization functions, giving first-layer units receptive fields without partitioning the domain or adding interface losses. We screen 13 families of localization functions, in up to three parameterizations each, on a nonlinear harmonic oscillator (HO), a heat equation on a long spatial interval, and a manufactured four-dimensional (4D) fourth-order problem, with ten paired seeds throughout. Three configurations give large reductions in solution error at matched budgets: (i) Fixed Gaussian localization functions on the $2\pi$ HO domain cut mean solution RMSE from $4.8369\times10^{-1}$ to $8.83\times10^{-3}$ at 3k epochs. translated_title: LPINNs：物理信息神经网络的首层门控定位方法
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在整个计算域上使用单一共享表示，这在长区间域和高阶算子的情况下可能变得难以优化。我们研究了一种极简的替代方案：在保持稠密PINN其余结构不变的前提下，将第一隐藏层激活乘以依赖于输入的定位函数，从而在不分割计算域、不添加界面损失的情况下，赋予第一层单元感受野。我们在非线性谐振子（HO）、长空间区间上的热传导方程，以及一个构造的四维（4D）四阶问题上，以最多三种参数化形式筛选了13族定位函数，全程使用十个配对随机种子。在匹配的计算预算下，三种配置大幅降低了求解误差：(i) 在 $2\pi$ 谐振子域上使用固定高斯定位函数，在3k个训练轮次后将平均解的RMSE从 $4.8369\times10^{-1}$ 降至 $8.83\times10^{-3}$。(ii) ……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出LPINNs，通过在标准PINN第一隐藏层激活上乘以依赖输入的定位函数（如高斯函数），在不分割计算域、不增加界面损失的前提下赋予网络局部感受野，从而在长域和高阶问题上大幅降低求解误差。
en_tdlr: LPINNs multiply the first hidden layer activations of an otherwise unchanged PINN by input-dependent localization functions, endowing the network with local receptive fields without domain partitioning or interface losses, and substantially reducing solution errors on long-domain and high-order problems.
